summary.description: Concise summary of the page review.

violations.description: Design-system, accessibility, schema, or content issues found in the page definition.

nodeId.description: Affected page node id, or an empty string when the finding is page-level.

message.description: What is wrong or worth reviewing.

suggestedFix.description: Specific next step to resolve the finding.

shouldBecomeGuidance.description: Potential new system guidance learned from this review.
